content: If disableEndToEndStateMachine is to TRUE, • The high nibble of the return of the function E2EXf_Inv_<transformerId> shall be set to 0x6. • The low nibble of the return of the function E2EXf_Inv_<transformerId> shall be set to the low nibble of the profile-independent check status of type E2E_PCheck StatusType. 49 of 77 Document ID 650: AUTOSAR_SWS_E2ETransformer Specification of Module E2E Transformer AUTOSAR CP R22-11
